title: Coherence contract catalog
description: The project's opt-in inventory of declared contract artifacts. It carries identity, relationships and status only -- each contract file stays authoritative for its own semantics, so this catalog must never become a second copy of contract content. Absence of the file is valid and produces no contract findings; presence makes every declared entry authoritative and fail-closed, which is why unknown fields are rejected at every level rather than tolerated.

schema.description: Explicit, versioned catalog identity. It is a `const` rather than a free string because every rule in this file is only meaningful for the version the tooling actually understands: a catalog that names a future or misspelled version must fail loudly here instead of being read as if it were v1.

contracts.description: Exact declarations only. There is deliberately no glob or directory form: a project opts in by naming each artifact, so no generic scan of JSON/YAML files is possible. An empty array is a valid, explicit empty inventory.

id.description: Stable declaration identity, referenced elsewhere as `contract:<id>`. Emptiness is not checked here: blank or non-string ids are reported by the model as CONTRACT_DECLARATION_INVALID so the diagnostic can name the offending declaration instead of collapsing into a generic document-level schema failure.

path.description: Repository-relative artifact path, interpreted with forward slashes. Lexical safety (rooted forms, `..` components, symlink escapes) is enforced before resolution by the catalog loader, not by this schema.

kind.description: Artifact family vocabulary owned by coherence.contracts.model.CONTRACT_KINDS. It is intentionally NOT an inline enum here: an unsupported kind must be reported per declaration as CONTRACT_KIND_UNSUPPORTED (naming the entry) rather than as an anonymous schema failure for the whole document.

status.description: Lifecycle state from coherence.contracts.model.CONTRACT_STATUSES. Required: an entry with no status is rejected, never silently defaulted. Membership is checked by the model (a present-but-unsupported value is reported per declaration as CONTRACT_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED), for the same per-declaration diagnostic reason as `kind`.

authority.description: Relationship ref `<kind>:<identifier>` naming the document that authorizes this artifact (for example `spec:SPEC-SENTINEL-WP0`).

validates_against.description: Relationship ref naming the declaration this artifact validates (for example `contract:SENTINEL-V0-WIRE-SCHEMA`).

consumers.description: Relationship refs to code or tests that consume this artifact. Order is preserved: it is the order edges and fingerprints are reported in.
